figures.caption: Figure 1. figures.label: I
figures.caption: Table I. Capacity losses of graphite/NMC cells after extended cycling at 1C (# of cycles is indicated) at different positive cutoff potentials (U) and temperatures (T). The electrochemically determined capacities at Beginning-of-Life (BoL), End-of-Life (EoL), and the thus determined capacity loss (ΔCcycling) are shown. The latter is compared to the capacity losses due to active lithium loss (ΔCactive-Li), obtained from XRD analysis of harvested NMC electrodes via quantification of the c/a-value by ex situ XRD, conversion into x in Li1-xNMC using the in situ XRD calibration curve (Figure 4d), and subtraction of the lithium ion loss due to ICL to yield the ICL-corrected x-value (xICL-corr.); note that x = 1 marks the theoretical capacity of 278 mAh/gNMC.
